_comment: Shared moves: recipe steps that several scenes need, by name. A scene uses one with { "move": "<name>" }. Every move except prepare_game starts from the clean state: a paused 1936 Germany game with all 30 divisions in Army 1, nothing selected, nothing open, the land map mode and the Home camera (what Invoke-GameCheck.ps1 gives before each scene, and Reset-HoiState restores). Map positions are measured in that view. Step kinds, how to find a recipe and what each move was tested on: wiki/Game-Recipes.md. Moves whose clicks are aimed in a scene of the 1440p UI mod (its reworked screens) stay in that repository.

prepare_game._note: Run once by the harness right after a new game has loaded, never by a scene: puts all 30 divisions into Army 1, so that every later recipe finds the same bottom bar. Doing it twice in one game does not work: the second box selection finds no unassigned divisions and the click lands on the map.

steps._note: the green + of the bottom bar: new army from the selection

select_all_divisions._note: A box over Germany and East Prussia in the Home view. Before prepare_game it selects the 30 unassigned divisions; used by prepare_game only.

select_army_1._note: Selects Army 1 (all 30 divisions) by its portrait in the bottom bar: the army badge and the division list come up.

select_airbase._note: The Niederschlesien airbase marker in the Home view: air map mode, the airbase row and its three wings.

open_diplomacy._note: On 1.19.3 the e key opens the international market panel.

open_recruit_deploy._note: Recruit & Deploy with the Division Templates panel beside it.

open_tank_designer._note: Production, add tank line, then the modify icon of the first design (Panzer II). Raw position inside a vanilla panel: when the mod reworks that panel, replace it with a clickWidget step.

open_plane_designer._note: Production, add plane line, then the modify icon of the first design. Raw position inside a vanilla panel: when the mod reworks that panel, replace it with a clickWidget step.

open_ship_designer._note: Production, add ship line, then the modify icon of the first class (Scharnhorst). Raw position inside a vanilla panel: when the mod reworks that panel, replace it with a clickWidget step.

open_advisor_selection._note: Politics, then the first empty political advisor slot. Raw position inside a vanilla panel: when the mod reworks that panel, replace it with a clickWidget step.

open_focus_tree._note: Politics, then the national focus box. Raw position inside a vanilla panel: when the mod reworks that panel, replace it with a clickWidget step.

open_tech_tree._note: Research, then the first research slot. Raw position inside a vanilla panel: when the mod reworks that panel, replace it with a clickWidget step.
